name: Acadev
blurb: Workshops, bootcamps, and hands-on curriculum that take members from their first notebook to production-ready skills.
description:
We lead and teach the DeCal course, “Introduction to Real World Data Science,” helping students of all experience levels build practical data science skills beyond the classroom.

Through a project-based curriculum, mentorship from our committee members, and an end-to-end team project using a real-world dataset, students gain the hands-on experience needed to tackle real data science and machine learning problems.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between classroom learning and industry practice, empowering students to build confidence and thrive in the rapidly evolving world of data science.

name: Consulting
blurb: Semester-long engagements where teams partner with real companies to ship data solutions and deliver insights.
description:
TODO: finalize with committee leadership. We partner with companies ranging from early-stage startups to Fortune 500s to tackle real, high-stakes data problems — from building predictive models to designing dashboards that shape executive decisions.

Each semester-long engagement pairs a small team of students with a client stakeholder, mirroring the cadence and rigor of a real consulting relationship.

Members leave with a portfolio of shipped work, direct client-facing experience, and a technical toolkit spanning the full analytics stack, from data cleaning to communicating insights that actually get acted on.

name: Social Good
blurb: The Social Good committee is focused on data done right. We care deeply about modern issues the rapid pace of technology comes with and how to tackle them.
description:
We provide pro-bono support for non-profit organizations, developing advanced analytical insights to recognize uplifting initiatives around the globe.

By using ‘tech for social good’, our diverse team of talented individuals prides itself on the impact it makes working on meaningful projects across the societal, healthcare, and environmental domains.

We focus our efforts not only on providing effective solutions to real-world issues, but also on addressing ethical challenges within the tech landscape — a need made increasingly evident by the rapid advancement of technology and the prevalence of data in today’s world. In our committee, we strive to instill a passion for ethical commitment within our members as they prepare to pursue their professional endeavors.
